card.name: Supplied-in packaging phrases
card.fires_on: Small words right after 'supplied in', 'available in' or 'provided in' in dosing sections, just before the container or pack type (ampules, cartridges, single-dose containers, bulk packages).

modes.label: Linking word before container
modes.description: 'in' after supplied, available or provided, ahead of the container type.
modes.example: Articaine HCl and Epinephrine (articaine HCl and epinephrine) Injection is available<< in>> glass cartridges.

modes.label: Descriptor before pack type
modes.description: Words like single, pharmacy, different or two that start the description of a pack or form.
modes.example: Linezolid injection is supplied in<< single>>-use, ready-to-use flexible plastic containers

card.writes: It pushes toward words for pack size, packaging and batch, including Chinese terms for specification and packaging.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where the text is about to say how the product is packaged or supplied.
